champion_selection_methodology: On the validation partition, evaluate thresholds from 0.05 to 0.95 in 0.01 increments. Among thresholds with false-positive rate <= 0.20, maximize defect-pattern recall; break ties by F1, precision, lower false-positive rate, then the higher threshold. Select the model using those validation operating points, prioritizing recall, PR-AUC, F1, and lower false-positive rate in that order.
